name: Schedule I
description: Chatters become customers in Schedule I: !customer puts their name on a customer in your game, and chat hears when they order or buy. Needs the FridgeSchedule1 MelonLoader mod (or its mock server on port 3857).

command_group.description: Schedule I customers and mix names (!customer, !topcustomers, !mug, !mixname)

pages.title: Schedule I customers
pages.keywords: schedule one schedule i customers chatters names npc

settings.label: Mod URL
settings.help: Where the FridgeSchedule1 mod (or START Schedule1 Mock.bat) listens

settings.label: Mod token
settings.help: Optional. Same text as Token in the mod's MelonPreferences.cfg

settings.label: Join without !customer
settings.help: subs = subscribers / members join when they chat; everyone = every chatter

settings.label: Name customers you've already met first
Newly named customers text you an order soon
settings.help: When a chatter's name lands on a customer you've already met, that customer texts you an order a few seconds later (unless they already have a deal, an open order or a dealer). In co-op only the host's setting counts.

settings.label: Only put chatter names on the extra regulars
settings.help: Only the ten Regulars (FridgeRegulars.dll) carry chatter names; everyone else waits for one. Chatters on normal customers move to a free Regular or back to waiting. Pair it with Shifts so names take turns.

settings.label: Most named customers at once
settings.help: 0 = every customer can carry a chatter name

settings.label: Shift ends after this many deals
settings.help: 0 = off. When someone is waiting, a chatter whose customer made this many deals goes to the back of the line and the next chatter takes over. Their totals are kept.

settings.label: Shift ends after (minutes)
settings.help: 0 = off. Same as above, by time on the customer (for customers who rarely order).

settings.label: Subscribers / members keep their customer
settings.help: Shifts never end for subs. Updated when they type !customer or join on their own.

settings.label: Say in chat when someone becomes a customer
Say in chat when a chatter-customer orders
Say in chat when a chatter-customer's deal goes through
Show stream alerts on the in-game phone
settings.help: Follows, subs, raids, tips ... pop up on your phone in Schedule I and go into the Chat app's feed. The Alerts page's test buttons work too.

settings.label: Which alerts
settings.help: Empty = all of them. Or pick kinds: follow, subscribe, resub, gift, raid, host, bits, superchat, donation, member, ...

settings.label: Chat can mug you (!mug)
settings.help: A chatter pays points and cartel goons come out of the nearest building after you. In co-op it hits your own player.

settings.label: Price (points)
settings.help: Refunded when the game can't do it (no save loaded, you're knocked out, no goons free).

settings.label: 'Let chat name it' button on the naming screen
settings.help: When you make a new mix, press 'Let chat name it' on the game's naming screen: chat suggests names with !mixname, then votes !1 !2 ... Press the button again (or name it yourself) to stop.

settings.label: Time for name ideas (s)
settings.help: 0 = no ideas from chat: chat votes on the game's own name ideas straight away.

settings.label: Names to vote on
settings.help: The ideas most chatters suggested go in first; the game's own ideas fill the rest.

settings.label: Always include one of the game's names
Name the mix as soon as the vote ends
settings.help: Off = chat's pick is typed into the name box and you press Confirm yourself (or change it).

settings.label: Words never allowed in a name
settings.help: Ideas containing any of these (any case, also inside longer words) are refused.
